query: What are the thematic fields covered by Horizon Europe?
response:
Horizon Europe (€95.5 billion) is structured around three main Pillars, which define its core thematic fields and funding types. The primary thematic areas are covered by the six 'Clusters' within Pillar II.

## Horizon Europe Thematic Fields (The Three Pillars)

### Pillar I: Excellent Science
This pillar supports fundamental, frontier research, typically led by individual top researchers or small teams. The goal is to reinforce and extend the excellence of the Union’s science base.

*   **European Research Council (ERC):** Funds investigator-driven research across all fields.
*   **Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA):** Funds mobility, training, and career development for researchers.
*   **Research Infrastructures:** Develops and consolidates European research infrastructures.

### Pillar II: Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness
This pillar is the core focus for collaborative R&I funding, addressing major societal challenges and supporting key EU policy priorities (like the Green Deal and Digital Transition). It is organised into six thematic **Clusters**.

| Cluster | Thematic Focus | Key Policy Areas || :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cluster 1** | Health | Health innovation, personalised medicine, infectious diseases. |
| **Cluster 2** | Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society | Governance, heritage, social transformation, democratic resilience. |
| **Cluster 3** | Civil Security for Society | Disaster resilience, border management, cybersecurity. |
| **Cluster 4** | Digital, Industry and Space | AI, robotics, manufacturing, key enabling technologies, satellite data. |
| **Cluster 5** | Climate, Energy and Mobility | Green transition, sustainable energy systems, clean transport, circular economy. |
| **Cluster 6** | Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture and Environment | Biodiversity, sustainable food systems (Farm to Fork), pollution control, rural areas. |

### Pillar III: Innovative Europe
This pillar aims to make Europe the leading continent for deep-tech innovation and startup creation.

*   **European Innovation Council (EIC):** Supports market-creating innovation and high-risk, high-impact technologies (specifically EIC Pathfinder, Transition, and Accelerator).
*   **European Innovation Ecosystems:** Connects regional and national innovation actors.
*   **European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT):** Works to integrate business, research, and education.

## How to Explore Thematic Opportunities

To find specific topics within these thematic fields, you must consult the official **Work Programmes** associated with each Cluster.

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for your cluster
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
